title: Chapter 300: Road Blocking
content:
Chapter 300: Road Blocking

Seeing the strange scenes around, Lu Xue and others no longer hesitated and quickly got up and left.

In just a blink of an eye, several people left the scope of the giant sword.

And just after a few people left.

Rumble!

This giant sword that was reaching the sky and the earth came up, and then a shocking scene appeared.

A giant hand slowly emerged from the hilt of the sword.

The next moment, the huge body, limbs, and head appeared one after another.

A giant standing in the depths of the ancient battlefield, his posture of standing tall and earth attracted attention. Everyone who saw it was stunned and could not help but tremble.

It is hard to believe what kind of strength this giant is.

Lu Xue and his group, who had already left, looked back and were immediately startled to sweat.

"Is this the master of that giant sword??"

"Has he resurrected?!"

"No."

Lu Xue was still a little calm, looked at the giant in the distance, and said in a deep voice: "This should be just a phantom, not the original body."

"Look at it."

Lu Xue pointed to the distance.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and the others looked in that direction and immediately took a breath of cold air.

I saw countless terrifying existences suddenly appearing.

Every existence exudes a terrifying aura.

Among them, the lowest is the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Although they are both in the Immortal Emperor Realm, the gap is still too big.

Even if those existences are just phantoms, not the essence, they are still as small as ants when they stand in front of them.

Is this the group of strong men back then?

It's indeed so terrifying.

Xiao Luo and Qin Feng looked at Lu Xue.

Others don’t know, but they know that all this was done by Lu Xue’s invincible father.

Is this a test for Lu Xue?

But, this is too scary.

Now, their goal is no longer to search for resources in the ancient battlefield, so as to quickly improve their strength.

But how should they survive and leave the ancient battlefield safely.

Not only Lu Xue and others were panicked.

The same is true for the rest of the ancient battlefield.

"Young Master, what should I do now? Something against the will of heaven seems to have happened in the ancient battlefield, and it is already extremely unstable."

An old man with a deep breath looked at a simple boy with a somewhat anxious look.

Upon hearing this, a rare look of fear appeared in the simple boy's eyes. He was silent for a moment and slowly said, "I can only find a way to leave the ancient battlefield first."

With the current situation on the ancient battlefield, if you continue to stay here, you will undoubtedly die, even if you don’t have the strength.

You know, he doesn't even look down on the evil list.

Hearing the boy's words, the old man nodded without any objection, and then took out a map.

"Young master, go there, the danger is the least there."

"Let's go."

......

On the other side, an illusory figure was speeding rapidly in the ancient battlefield.

"Damn it, what the hell is going on?"

Chu Lingsheng had a rare look on his face.

I finally entered the ancient battlefield and I only got a lot of money, so this kind of change happened.

What's more, he had to work for others. Thinking of this, he suddenly remembered that it was so dangerous in the ancient battlefield, so Lu Xue and the others wouldn't have been there.

After pondering for a long time, Chu Lingsheng sighed slightly.

"Forget it, go and have a look."

After all, he promised Lu Xue that he would save their lives.

However, the crisis on the ancient battlefield has increased many times. Whether it can be saved is still the same thing.

.........

boom!

The violent power continued to rage.

An unknown powerful figure blocked Lu Xue and others.

Looking at the phantom in front of him, Lu Xue looked solemn.

The phantom in front of me was definitely the peak powerhouse in the Immortal Emperor realm during his lifetime, and was also the best among them.

"Sister Xue, what should I do? Why don't we take a detour?"

Xiao Luo hesitated.

The existence in front of them is too strong, and they cannot defeat their opponents at this moment.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue also said helplessly: "Take a detour."

Then several people changed directions and headed towards another place.

Although these powerful figures are all terrifying, fortunately, they are basically unaware of it and only have some basic attacks.

But even so, they were helpless.

However, just as Lu Xue and others continued to move forward, the phantom appeared in front of them again, blocking their way.

"What?!"

Several people looked at the phantom in front of them in horror, shocked and angry.

Why, they still depend on them?

At this time, Lu Xue also began to look at the phantom in front of her. She was obviously a human, tall, naked, her clothes were already rotten, and her eyes were extremely empty.

There was something similar to a wallet hanging around his waist.

It seems like there is really a treasure inside.

"Xiao Luo, go and meet him."

"ah?"

Xiao Luo couldn't believe it when he heard Lu Xue's words.

"I?"

Looking at Xiao Luo's incredible gaze, Lu Xue nodded, "It's you."

Seeing this, Xiao Luo's face suddenly collapsed.

Although this guy in front of him was just a phantom and did not have the original owner's former strength, he was definitely an existence in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

I am really not sure.

But looking at Lu Xue's unquestionable gaze, Xiao Luo slowly stepped forward.

"Come on, I'll meet you."

Xiao Luo's eyes were covered with a hint of determination, and his combat power was suddenly boiling.

The next moment.

boom!

Xiao Luo flew out directly.

"So strong, I'm afraid even I can't solve the problem with such strength."

Next to Lu Xue, Qin Feng murmured as he looked at the scene in front of him.

It's already this time, Qin Feng still doesn't forget to pretend to be a fool.

Lu Xue just rolled her eyes to this, but she saw something.

The phantom in front of me seems to be not a life-seeking effort.

If you want to kill them, you will have already taken action.

I just asked Xiao Luo to come on, and I just tested it. Now, Xiao Luo is only seriously injured, but he is not dead.

But, what exactly does this guy in front of him want to do?

Lu Xue began to ponder.

At this time, Ao Qing suddenly said, "My master, is this guy hungry? Why don't you give him some food?"

When Lu Xue heard Ao Qing's words, his face turned pale.

"I think you're eating!"

"Come on!"

As he said that, Lu Xue threw Ao Qing towards the phantom in the distance.

"Damn it, you'll sell me!"

boom!

Without any surprise, the phantom punched out again, and even Ao Qing, who was strong in body, was knocked away by a punch.

Seeing this, Qin Feng beside Lu Xue was uneasy.

If this continues, isn’t it my turn next?

Qin Feng looked at Lu Xue carefully with his light, for fear that Lu Xue would suddenly speak.

Qin Feng, you come on.

No, absolutely not.

"Sister Xue, I don't think this guy wants to fight or kill. Why don't you talk to him?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue took a deep breath and then suppressed the anger in her heart.

She once thought her mind was already very bad.

But others have no brains at all.

"Go, go, go talk to him."

Lu Xue said in a turmoil.

Upon hearing this, Qin Feng had no choice but to do so.

"I, I'll try it."

After a moment, Qin Feng waved to Lu Xue, "Sister Xue, it's done!"

Lu Xue:! ?
